caption: The drawing depicts a single long, double-breasted overcoat with a high collar, wide lapels, and full-length sleeves. The coat is rendered in shades of brown with fine vertical white pinstripes running throughout its entirety, giving it a textured appearance. The coat features six buttons visible on the front arranged in two parallel rows and has a fitted upper body with a flared skirt extending to the ankles. There is no visible background detail; the coat is centered against a plain, off-white background. The inner lining of the coat’s collar is suggested with a slightly lighter shade of brown, and the fabric’s folds and seams are indicated with subtle shading and line work.
title: Man's Dressing Gown
